title: Anomaly.Char.Effects
description: Snapshot (module Anomaly.Char): the character's active effects with rounds left. Sent when an effect starts, ends or changes; roundsLeft counts down at the diff points (A.3).

roundsLeft.description: rounds left; null for an effect without a timer

magnitude.description: the effect's value rolled when it was cast (the engine's ActiveSpell.CastLevel, which despite that name is NOT a level: the spell's min..max, level-scaled), used for the spell's ability slots whose own value is 0, e.g. a mana flux's regen or a haste's speed. Not the caster's level

caster.description: who cast it, ONLY when the engine stored it and A.7 allows the name (a monster, the receiver, a party member, or a player visible in the room); otherwise null, never inferred. This build stores no caster for effects on a character, so it is null for every effect until the engine records one
